definitions.explanation: A formal honorific term of address used to address a group of people respectfully. Commonly used in business emails, official notices, and formal announcements. Equivalent to "Dear all" or "To whom it may concern."

examples.japanese: ⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧{各位|かくい}
⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧{各位|かくい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: We would like to inform all employees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧{各位|かくい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧おかれましては、⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧ご{健勝|けんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こととお{慶|よろこ}び⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: We are pleased to hope that all members are in good health.

notes:
USAGE:
{各位|かくい} is itself an honorific, so adding さま or {殿|どの} after it is considered redundant, though {各位|かくい}さま is sometimes seen in practice. Typically placed after a group noun: ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧{各位|かくい}, ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧{各位|かくい}, ⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧{各位|かくい}. Used primarily in written communication — business emails, notices, and circulars.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧{各位|かくい}: to all employees
- ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧{各位|かくい}: to all members
- ⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧{各位|かくい}: to all concerned parties
- ⟦{保護者|ほごしゃ}→保護者：11564_hogosha⟧{各位|かくい}: to all parents/guardians
